guide.title: Setup guide
guide.subtitle: What a technician does, step by step, to turn a factory-new tablet into a kiosk that runs only {{kiosk}}. About 15 minutes per tablet.

prep.1: Upload Kiosk Admin and the {{kiosk}} package above (or let CI publish them). During setup the tablet downloads Kiosk Admin from here, and right after it {{kiosk}}.
prep.2: Do not add a Google account and do not install {{kiosk}} from Google Play. Kiosk Admin installs and updates it from here; a Google Play copy is signed with a different key, so every update would fail.
prep.3: Create the setup QR code above with a technician PIN and keep the PIN safe: it is the only way out of the kiosk.
prep.title: Before you start (once)

setup.1: Right before you scan, knock from the setup network with your device credential, so the tablet can download Kiosk Admin.
setup.2: Factory reset the tablet: Settings → General management → Reset → Factory data reset.
setup.3: On the welcome screen, tap the same spot six times. A QR scanner opens; scan the code from this page.
setup.4: Connect to Wi-Fi if the QR code does not carry it. The tablet downloads Kiosk Admin and says the organisation manages it; finish the setup.
setup.5: Kiosk Admin opens in service mode and installs {{kiosk}} by itself; progress is shown on the screen. Keep the tablet on Wi-Fi. If nothing happens, tap “Update now”.
setup.6: Then tap “Start kiosk”. The app starts locked; Home and Recents do nothing.
setup.7: Sign the driver in. The app registers its device credential; approve it in the “Door credentials” tab so the tablet can knock by itself over mobile data (see the note there on when an approval reaches the door).
setup.title: Setting up a tablet

run.1: Between {{window}}, while charging, Kiosk Admin installs newer versions of {{kiosk}} and of itself, then starts the app again. Leave tablets on the charger overnight.
run.2: Location stays on and the clock comes from the network; both are part of the delivery evidence. The camera works inside the kiosk.
run.title: In operation

out.1: If holding the power button does nothing (in the kiosk it often does not), force a restart: hold the side button and volume down together for about 10 seconds.
out.2: During Kiosk Admin's countdown after the restart, tap its name at the top seven times and enter the technician PIN. The screen shows this hint as well.
out.3: Service mode turns the kiosk off and lifts the restrictions (Settings, Wi-Fi, USB debugging). “Start kiosk” locks the tablet again.
out.4: Service mode shows the versions of Kiosk Admin and of {{kiosk}}; “Update now” fetches updates right away. If service mode has no “Update now”, Kiosk Admin is an old build that cannot update itself: release the tablet, factory reset it and set it up again from a new QR code.
out.5: Five wrong PINs pause entry for five minutes. Without the PIN, the only way back is a reset from recovery mode (hardware buttons); if a Google account was ever added, the tablet then asks for it.
out.title: Service: getting out of the kiosk

release.1: In service mode, “Release tablet” removes Kiosk Admin's control and the tablet becomes an ordinary device. Managing it again needs a factory reset and the QR code.

faq.title: Answers to Your Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about the AISHA Dirigent platform, AI-powered development, and how Evymo can help your project succeed.

q1.question: What is AISHA Dirigent?
q1.answer: AISHA Dirigent is an AI orchestration platform developed by Evymo. It coordinates specialized AI agents that assist throughout the entire software development lifecycle — from planning and implementation through testing to deployment and operations. The name "Dirigent" (conductor) reflects its role: orchestrating the work of multiple AI agents and human specialists into a cohesive workflow.

q2.question: Who is Evymo?
q2.answer: Evymo s.r.o. is a Czech technology company that builds AI-powered tools for software development and project delivery. We connect clients who need custom software with qualified specialists, and provide them with AISHA — our AI platform that accelerates development, maintains quality standards, and reduces costs.

q3.question: Who is the platform designed for?
q3.answer: AISHA serves two audiences: clients who need custom software built reliably and cost-effectively, and specialists (developers, architects, consultants) who want to amplify their capabilities with AI-powered tooling. Whether you're a startup needing an MVP or an enterprise requiring complex integrations, the platform adapts to your needs.

q1.question: What technology stack does the platform use?
q1.answer: The platform is built on React with TypeScript for the frontend, PostgreSQL 17 with PostgREST behind AISHA Gateway for the backend, Keycloak for authentication, n8n for workflow automation, and Elasticsearch for knowledge retrieval. Function endpoints run as self-hosted services behind the gateway. The entire stack is designed for self-hosting and can be deployed to any infrastructure.

q2.question: Can AISHA be self-hosted?
q2.answer: Yes. AISHA is designed for self-hosted deployment. The platform runs in Docker containers and can be deployed via Coolify, Docker Compose, or any container orchestration system. Your data stays on your infrastructure — we never require cloud dependencies that you don't control.

q3.question: What programming languages and frameworks does AISHA support?
q3.answer: AISHA's knowledge base and agent system are language-agnostic in principle. The platform itself is built with TypeScript and React, but AI agents can assist with projects in any major language or framework. The knowledge system can be trained on any technology stack your project requires.

q1.question: How do the AI agents work?
q1.answer: AISHA uses a catalog of seven specialized agents, each with a defined purpose: the Dirigent coordinates workflows, the Librarian manages knowledge, the Compliance Gate enforces quality standards, the Dev Patch implements changes, the Verifier validates results, the Planner creates project plans, and the Debug Agent diagnoses issues. They work together, with the Dirigent routing tasks to the right agent based on context.

q2.question: Do the AI agents replace human developers?
q2.answer: No. AI agents amplify human capabilities, they don't replace them. A specialist always oversees the work, makes architectural decisions, and reviews results. The agents handle repetitive tasks, enforce standards, search knowledge bases, and accelerate implementation — freeing specialists to focus on creative and strategic work.

q3.question: What is the knowledge base system?
q3.answer: Every project builds a knowledge base of expert rules, architectural patterns, coding conventions, and domain-specific information. AI agents consult this knowledge before making any change, ensuring consistency across the entire codebase. The system uses vector search and text matching to find relevant knowledge for each task.

q1.question: What services does Evymo offer?
q1.answer: We offer three core services: Managed Development (specialist + AI agents build your project), Operations Oversight (monitoring, quality gates, and compliance checking for existing projects), and Maintenance & Support (ongoing bug fixes, updates, and infrastructure management). Each service can be engaged independently or combined.

q2.question: How does a typical project work?
q2.answer: You describe what you need, we assign a specialist who configures AISHA for your project's technology stack and domain. The specialist works alongside AI agents who handle implementation while the Dirigent ensures quality standards. Projects typically deliver in weeks, not months, because AI agents work continuously and iterate in real time.

q3.question: Can I keep the code after the project?
q3.answer: Absolutely. All code, documentation, and knowledge bases created during the project belong to you. There is no vendor lock-in. You can maintain the code yourself, hire another team, or continue with us for ongoing support — the choice is entirely yours.

q1.question: How is my data protected?
q1.answer: Security is built into every layer: Row-Level Security (RLS) on all database tables, audit logging for every sensitive operation, encrypted connections (TLS 1.2+), and no personal data in logs or error messages. The platform follows OWASP Top 10 guidelines and undergoes regular security reviews.

q2.question: Where does the code and data run?
q2.answer: On infrastructure you control. AISHA is self-hosted by design. For managed services, we deploy to EU-based infrastructure. Your source code, databases, and knowledge bases remain on your designated servers. We never share project data between clients.

q3.question: What compliance standards does the platform meet?
q3.answer: The platform is designed with SOC 2 principles in mind: comprehensive audit trails, role-based access control, data isolation between tenants, and automated compliance gates that validate every change. All database operations are logged, and access to sensitive data requires explicit authorization.

q1.question: What do the different plans include?
q1.answer: Starter includes community projects with up to 3 specialists, ideal for smaller engagements. Professional adds advanced analytics, priority matching, and supports up to 10 specialists. Enterprise provides SLA guarantees, a dedicated Dirigent coordinator, custom integrations, and unlimited specialists.

q2.question: Is there a free trial or proof of concept?
q2.answer: Yes. We offer a free Proof of Concept phase where we configure AISHA for your specific use case and demonstrate the platform's capabilities on a small scope. This lets you evaluate the quality and speed of AI-assisted development before committing to a full engagement.

q3.question: How does pricing work?
q3.answer: Pricing is project-based and depends on scope and complexity. Typically, AI-assisted development costs about half of traditional outsourcing because agents handle repetitive work while specialists focus on high-value tasks. Your specialist provides a specific estimate after a free consultation.

hero.title: Getting started with AISHA
hero.subtitle: A short course for new users: what AISHA is, how it thinks, and how to get a real result out of it in your first ten minutes.

whatIs.title: 1. What AISHA is and how it thinks
whatIs.intro: AISHA is not a single chatbot. It is an AI orchestrator — a platform that picks the right approach, model and tools for each task, and does everything under supervision and with an audit trail. Four principles that will make your life easier:

stories.title: Stories = your projects
stories.text: Everything revolves around stories. A story is the workspace of one project or initiative: it has its own knowledge base, an activity timeline and rulesets. Whatever AISHA does, it does in the context of a specific story — knowledge and outputs never leak between projects.

backend.title: The AI picks the backend per task
backend.text: You don't configure a model. For each task, AISHA selects a suitable language model and processing path based on the task type, cost and availability. You describe what you need — choosing "what to do it with" is the orchestrator's job.

governance.title: Governance: fail loud rather than err quietly
governance.text: The platform is designed fail-loud. When something can't be done, or data or permissions are missing, you hear about it directly — instead of a silent guess dressed up as an answer. Sensitive actions pass through approval gates, and privileged operations are written to the audit journal.

dirigent.title: Dirigent: supervision of AI agents
dirigent.text: AISHA Dirigent continuously watches the work of AI agents and course-corrects it — advisory, not by force. Agent outputs get a second pair of eyes before they reach you.

firstSteps.title: 2. Your first 10 minutes
firstSteps.intro: The shortest path from login to a first result.

step1.title: Sign in
step1.text: You sign in via single sign-on (Keycloak) on the /auth page. Your preview access arrived by e-mail; you set your own password on first login.

step2.title: Open your first story
step2.text: In the Stories section, open the story prepared for you (or have a new one created). Browse the Overview, Timeline and Knowledge tabs — you'll see what AISHA knows about the project and what has happened in it so far.

step3.title: Send your first chat message
step3.text: Open the AI chat and ask something about the project. Start specific: "Summarize the knowledge in this story" is a better first question than "What can you do?". Watch the Sources used panel next to answers — it shows what the answer is grounded in.

step4.title: Run your first flowboard
step4.text: The flowboard is a canvas where you draw a workflow from nodes — Triggers, Agents, MCP Tools, Actions and Gates — and press Run to execute it. When a flow hits an approval gate, you'll see the "awaiting approval" state: review what is about to happen and confirm Approve and continue. Not sure how to assemble the flow? Use Ask AISHA right on the canvas.

step5.title: Bonus: browse the Agent Marketplace
step5.text: The agent catalog offers ready-made specialized agents you can install into your story — they then run in its context and with its knowledge.

workingWithAi.title: 3. How to work with AI effectively
workingWithAi.intro: AI is a powerful but fallible colleague. These few habits make the biggest difference between frustration and a great result.

context.title: Context decides
context.text: The model knows nothing you don't tell it. Describe what you want, for whom, in what format, and how you'll know it's done. One well-written sentence of instructions saves three rounds of clarification.

knowledge.title: Feed the knowledge base
knowledge.text: Upload materials into the story's Knowledge tab (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD up to 50 MB) or add entries by hand. AISHA draws on them through multilingual retrieval that handles Czech natively — a question asked in Czech finds English documents and vice versa. The better the sources, the less the AI makes things up.

verify.title: Trust, but verify
verify.text: Language models sometimes state things that aren't true — and sound confident doing it. That's why AISHA shows Sources used and a faithfulness badge next to answers; take the warning "Low faithfulness — verify the answer before using it" seriously. Always check facts, numbers and anything leaving the company against the source.

iterate.title: Iterate, don't dictate
iterate.text: The first answer is a draft, not a verdict. React: "shorten this", "back it with a source", "rewrite it for the customer". Short iterations beat one long perfect prompt.

rules.title: The minimum to remember
items: AI output is a draft — responsibility for the result stays with you.
The more specific the brief and the better the sources, the better the result.
Double-check answers that cite no sources.
Don't paste data into the chat that doesn't belong in the project.
When AISHA doesn't know, it says so out loud — that's by design, not a bug.

preview.title: 4. What "preview" means
preview.intro: You are using a live but early version of the platform. What to expect:
limits: Features change and grow; occasionally something creaks or gets rebuilt.
AI response speed and quality may vary with the selected backend and current load.
Some areas (for example the Flowboard) are enabled gradually based on role and permissions.
Your data runs on self-hosted infrastructure in the EU (Czech Republic), with no third-party trackers. You can request account deletion at any time on the /account/delete page.

feedback.title: Your feedback drives what comes next
feedback.text: Hit a bug, something doesn't make sense, or a feature is missing? Write to us at ask@aisha.guru. During the preview we read everything and reply fast — feedback from these weeks directly sets the order of upcoming changes.

closing.title: Now go for it
closing.text: The fastest way to get comfortable with AISHA is to give it a real task from your project — not a toy exercise. Open a story, upload your first document and ask. You'll learn the rest as you go.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.fullText:
## 1. Who is the controller

The AISHA platform at aisha.guru (the "Service") is operated by **Evymo** ("we", the "Operator"), who acts as the controller of your personal data. For all privacy matters, contact us at **ask@aisha.guru**.

The Service is currently offered as a **public preview**. This policy describes how we handle personal data during the preview.

## 2. What personal data we process

- **Account data** — your name, e-mail address and sign-in records. Identity and authentication are handled by our self-hosted Keycloak instance; account data is not shared with external identity providers unless you choose to sign in through one.
- **Content you create** — projects, documents, knowledge-base entries and other material you store in the Service.
- **AI interaction data** — the prompts you submit, the responses generated and related metadata (timestamps, selected model). This data is necessary to provide the Service and to investigate malfunctions.
- **Audit and security logs** — privileged and security-relevant actions are recorded in an audit journal to protect the Service and its users.

We do **not** use third-party analytics, advertising trackers or fingerprinting. The web application stores only your language preference and your authentication session in your browser.

## 3. Purposes and legal bases (Art. 6 GDPR)

- Providing the Service you signed up for — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).
- Security, abuse prevention and audit logging — our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- Optional features you opt into (e.g. product news) — your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time.
- Compliance with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).

## 4. AI providers as processors

When you use AI features, the content of your request (and the necessary context) is transmitted through our LLM gateway to the AI model provider configured for your instance, which acts as our processor. We do not sell your data and we do not permit its use for advertising. Where a configured provider processes data outside the EU/EEA, transfers are covered by appropriate safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

## 5. Where your data is stored

Application data is stored in a self-hosted PostgreSQL database and identity data in a self-hosted Keycloak instance, on infrastructure located in the European Union (Czech Republic).

## 6. Retention

- **Account data and content**: for as long as your account exists.
- **Account deletion**: you can request erasure at any time on the **/account-deletion** page. The request enters a 30-day grace period (during which you can cancel it); after it expires, your account and content are erased.
- **Audit and security logs**: kept for a limited period necessary for security and legal compliance, then deleted.
- **Backups**: erased data leaves backups as backup cycles rotate.

## 7. Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and the right to withdraw consent at any time. You can exercise erasure directly at **/account-deletion** and portability via the data export function; for anything else, write to **ask@aisha.guru**. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — in the Czech Republic the Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ, uoou.gov.cz).

## 8. Security

Access to data follows the principle of least privilege, is protected by row-level security in the database and encrypted in transit, and privileged actions are recorded in the audit journal.

## 9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy, in particular as the preview evolves towards general availability. Material changes will be announced in the Service.

Questions? **ask@aisha.guru**

retisin.name: Demo Product 1 (DEMO-01)
retisin.description: From a molecular biology perspective, Retisin targets the fundamental restoration of cellular energetics and immune surveillance. Its primary benefit is the modulation of the organism's 'terrain' – optimizing the environment for regenerative processes. It acts as a strong roborant (strengthening agent), historically proven to increase the organism's overall resistance and suppress fermentative processes (often associated with the Warburg effect in pathological tissues) in favor of oxidative metabolism. It is ideal for states of exhaustion, convalescence after invasive procedures or radiotherapy, and for supporting hematopoiesis.

origin.description: Deproteinized ethanol extract from bovine tissue with a specific spectrum of low-molecular bioactive substances.

source.title: Bovine Tissue
source.description: Obtained from certified organic farms with strict quality control.

production.title: Extraction
production.description: Specific ethanol extraction preserving low-molecular bioactive substances.

energy.title: Cellular Energy Restoration
energy.description: Targets fundamental restoration of cellular energetics and optimization of metabolic processes.

immunity.title: Immune Surveillance
immunity.description: Modulates the organism's 'terrain' and optimizes the environment for regenerative processes.

resistance.description: Historically proven increase in overall organism resistance and suppression of fermentative processes.

recovery.title: Convalescence

substances.peptides: Bioactive peptides and oligopeptides (defensins, hemocidins) with immunomodulatory function

application.description: Orally. Application under the tongue is recommended for rapid absorption through the mucosa and bypassing liver metabolism (first-pass effect). Form: 30ml drops (solution).

distribution.description: Standard productation involves 1–2 ml daily (approx. 20–40 drops), ideally on an empty stomach or away from food to maximize absorption of peptide components.

chronic.description: Suitable for long-term use in cycles (e.g., 3 months use, 1 month break) to maintain receptor sensitivity.

floristen.name: Demo Product 2 (DEMO-02)
floristen.description: Floristen represents a unique approach to phytotherapy for chronic inflammation. Unlike common St. John's Wort extracts, this tool is designed to eliminate phototoxic components and maximize non-specific anti-inflammatory effects. The mechanism involves inhibiting proliferative inflammatory processes and supporting the resorption of infiltrates (inflammatory foci). Historically proven in chronic gynecological inflammations and conditions resistant to antibiotic treatment, acting as a "herbal shield" and supporting tissue vascularization.

origin.title: Origin and Production
origin.description: Specifically prepared hydroalcoholic extract from Hypericum perforatum (St. John's Wort), focusing on the water-soluble fraction.

production.description: Elimination of phototoxic components, maximization of non-specific anti-inflammatory effect.

substances.phloroglucinols: Phloroglucinols (limited, modified hyperforin/adhyperforin) - preserved antimicrobial potential, minimized interactions
substances.naphthodianthrones: Naphthodianthrones (limited, minimized hypericin) - reduced photosensitivity risk, preserved antiviral potential

distribution.description: Standard 20–30 drops 2–3× daily. For chronic conditions, long-term administration (minimum 6–8 weeks) is key for tissue saturation with flavonoids.

lyastin.name: Demo Product 3 (DEMO-03)
lyastin.description: Lyastin targets the integrity of cell membranes and microcirculation. Its main benefit is improving the nutrition (trophics) of ischemic tissues and supporting the regeneration of vascular endothelium. It works by supplying essential building blocks for cell wall repair, acting as a vasodilator and spasmolytic. It is indicated for supporting peripheral circulation, regeneration after vascular events, and conditions associated with tissue degeneration due to hypoxia (lack of oxygen).

aria.deck: AISHA guide — slide deck with a quiz

s0.heading:
Is AI the thing
you mistype into
Google?
s0.body: Maybe AISHA is a bit early for you. But if you're curious, let's walk it together — what AI actually is, why it isn't magic, and why AISHA makes your decisions easier. It ends with a five-question test so you can see where you stand.
s0.cta_skip: Let me through, I'm a pro

s1.heading:
AI is a brilliant
donkey.
s1.body: It can think about anything in the world — word by word it guesses what you'd say next. But it stays completely dumb until you tell it where it stands, where it's going and what to deliver there. Without context it just brays.
s1.caption: Hallucination = a donkey nobody asked where it was going.

s2.heading:
There are dozens.
Each good at something else.
s2.body: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, Mistral... Every provider ships whole families of models. Some write brilliantly, others code, others converse, others see images. They differ in speed, price and what they're good for.
s2.caption: You don't need to know them one by one. AISHA does.

s3.heading: <accent>Context</accent> is everything.
s3.body: The same question gets a completely different answer in a different context. Without your documents, rules and history, AISHA guesses generically. With them, it speaks for you. That's called a knowledgebase — your private base of knowledge AISHA reaches into.
s3.answer_with: “Your project uses X, so do Y and avoid Z.”
s3.caption: Your documents never leave. They only help AISHA understand you.

s4.heading:
Not everything needs
the priciest model.
s4.body: An expensive model for everything = an expensive bill. AISHA knows when a local Qwen is enough, when a small Flash will do, and when Opus or GPT-5 has to step in. Batch processing adds a 50% discount at OpenAI and Anthropic — send it the queries that don't need an answer right away.
s4.caption: Five tiers. AISHA picks. You pay the minimum bill.

s5.heading: It's not just <accent>chat</accent>.
s5.body: Programming is only one of the domains. Here's a handful of ideas — pick yours. AISHA helps you build a knowledgebase and expert rules for any of them.
s5.uc1_desc: Texts in your brand voice, from the studio, blog, e-shop.
s5.uc2_desc: Your team's rules, not generic advice from the internet.
s5.uc3_desc: First line of answers, escalation to a human specialist.
s5.uc7_desc: An assistant for new hires, search across company policies.
s5.uc8_desc: Questions over CSVs, dashboards, Q&A over company data.

s6.heading:
Score 80 % or better
and AISHA is for you.
s6.body: It's not an exam. Just a quick check that we speak the same language. If something doesn't click, run the guide again and we move on. No shame.

q1.question: What does AI need most for a good answer?
q1.b: Context — knowing who is asking, about what and why
q1.hint: Without context it just brays — see the donkey picture.

q2.question: Why are there many different models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen…)?
q2.c: Each has different strength, price and speed — each fits something else
q2.hint: Flash is fast and cheap, Opus is expensive and smart, Qwen runs on your GPU for zero.

q3.question: What is a “knowledgebase”?
q3.b: Your private documents, rules and history the AI draws from
q3.c: A database in the provider's cloud
q3.hint: Your company, project, e-mails, contracts — everything that makes the answer make sense to you, not to just anyone.

q4.question: What is “batch” processing at OpenAI and Anthropic?
q4.a: Bulk queries with delayed answers — at a 50% discount
q4.hint: Send a thousand queries, get them back within 24 hours at half price. AISHA moves what doesn't need an instant answer into the batch queue by itself.

q5.question: When AI gets no context, what usually happens?
q5.b: It starts fluently making things up — it hallucinates
q5.hint: A model doesn't know the boundary of its own knowledge. It guesses. That's why the knowledgebase and context matter — they keep the donkey on the track.
